programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his way back.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: For some strange reason, Mr. Dickenson has sent the Blade Breakers to a remote mountain retreat to hone their blading skills for the upcoming American Tournament as well as to get Kenny and Dizzi to figure out a way to increase Ray's Bit Beast's power. Once there, they meet up with a enthusiastic young boy named Antonio who they think is there to train them. Turns out, Antonio is a pathetic blader.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.sub-title: Darkness At The End Of The Tunnel
programme.desc: After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: As the BladeBreakers make their way to the World Championships in Russia, they are stuck in Paris where they end up wasting a day looking for Kai who had mysteriously disappeared. Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part of their ultimate plan to capture all Bit Beasts in the world. A massive battle ensues but the odds are against our heroes. Finally, Kai shows up with his newly modified Dranzer and almost single-handedly wins the battle. The Dark Bladers fade away after their humiliating loss and just when you'd think it's over, a mysterious kid named Oliver shows up'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends. But Tyson soon convinces him to 'Let it rip!' And after seeing Enrique's personalized BeyStadium, and his outrageous bit-beast, there's a good chance that Tyson may regret his actions'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Unwilling to let his initial defeat to Enrique faze him, Tyson gets busy reworking his Beyblade. With Enrique having doubts about his own technique, and Oliver visiting him in Rome from France, the stage is set for a rematch. This time, Tyson pits the two heads of Enrique's Bit Beast Amphilyon against each other, and saves Enrique's life when Amphilyon turns on him.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Enrique and Oliver decide to take our heroes on a dirigible ride to visit Robert's castle. The reason - Tyson hopes to avenge an earlier loss to Robert that happened onboard the ship coming to Europe. Tyson's patience, however, is tested when they have to sit and wait for their host who is 'not to be disturbed.' So, Tyson decides to find Robert on his own and ends up getting lost in the medieval castles many eerie secret passages. Finally everyone converges in the room where Robert is playing chess against Johnny and it's here where Tyson throws down the gauntlet and challenges Robert to a rematch. Robert refuses and goes into a whole history lesson about how 'once you've defeated your enemy, the battle is over.' Meanwhile, the arrogant little Johnny decides to pick a battle with the most-worthy opponent in the room and chooses Kai. As the fight begins, it appears to be even, but then Johnny calls out his Bit Beast Salamulyon and totally destroys him. In the end, the Bladebreakers resolve that they have their work cut out for them to become the world champion Beybladers!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers have made themselves at home at Robert's mansion, refusing to leave unless the Europeans agree to a final Beybattle. To teach his guests a lesson, Robert agrees to a match at his new stadium. But there's one condition: If the Bladebreakers lose, they have to forfeit their berth at the world Championship. Ray and Oliver battle fiercely and the first round ends in a tie. Johnny and Kai, bitter rivals, step to the bowl. But can Kai defeat the man who defeated him?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Match two gets underway at the Olympia Coliseum, and with a little unsolicited help by his teammates, Kai walks away with a win. The match is tied and the Majestics grudgingly admit to themselves that the only way they'll win the contest is to fight as a team, as the Bladebreakers do. Facing off against Tyson in the final match, will Robert be able to apply the fundamentals of teamwork? And will the Bladebreakers ever discover who sent them on their cross-Europe trip in the first place'?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.sub-title: Hot Battle In A Cold Town
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should test his blading skills against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into deadly Beybladers. Kai's lost memories come flooding back as he realizes he was raised in the abbey. But has he discovered the truth too late?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Kai is torn between escaping the Abbey, and exploring it further in an attempt to unlock forgotten memories from his childhood. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. When Kai discovers the existence of Black Dranzer, the world's most powerful Beyblade, Boris offers it to him - but only if Kai quits the Bladebreakers forever and rejoins the Biovolt Corporation. Flooded with memories of using Black Dranzer as a child, and the lure of its dark, corrupting power leads Kai to a shocking decision.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the first day of the Beyblade World Championships in Moscow, and as our heroes leave their hotel, they still haven't been able to locate Kai who's been missing for some time. Regardless, they arrive at the tournament and meet up with both the White Tigers and the All Starz who invite them to watch their first match against the Demolition Boys. At first things seem fairly normal, that is, until they start to battle. Things go from bad to worse for the All Starz who are no match for the Demolition Boys who quickly go up 2-0 in the best of five events. In the next match, Michael has to square off against a mystery member of the Demolition Boys and it turns out to be none other than Kai who has defected from the Bladebreakers. In the final battle, Kai takes on all the All Starz at once' and wins!! After his victory, he commands the All Starz Bit Beasts to enter his blade and he announces to the world that he now possesses the most powerful Beyblade in the world!!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Determined to avenge the All-Starz' devastating defeat, the White Tigers face Kai in the Tournament. One by one, they fall before the power of Black Dranzer and watch, horrified, as their Bit Beasts are absorbed into Kai's Beyblade. The Bladebreakers storm the abbey in a desperate attempt to free their teammate. Tyson stumbles into Biovolt's secret lab and learns the truth about Kai's past from a gloating Boris. Tyson refuses to give up on his friend until Kai hands over his old Beyblade and tells him to leave. Will the Bladebreakers survive the loss of their most powerful member?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Downtrodden and dejected, the Bladebreakers ask themselves over and over again: 'Why would Kai betray us?' Soon enough, however, the boys get a chance to ask him themselves. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. Voltaire orders the operation to proceed, and Boris brings in the Demolition Boys to get the job done. It is revealed that BioVolt is creating a breed of powerful, savage, Bit-Beasts that are designed for War'and the plan is to use them to take over the entire World. The Demolition Boys attack the BBA bus, and Max bravely battles to save his friends. Unfortunately he loses his Bit-Beast, Draciel, in the process'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are stranded on the barren Russian Tundra after their run-in with the Demolition Boys when the Majestics mysteriously show up in their bus. After picking our heroes up, they stop at an abandoned palace where Robert challenges Tyson to battle. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Robert then tells Tyson that he must harness his power back into his blade, which totally confuses Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The World Championship Finals are finally here and Kai insists on Beybattling first, hoping his knowledge of the Demolition Boys will give him an advantage over Spencer. But in the first set, Seaborg, Spencer's whale Bit Beast, uses the water in the Black Sea Bowl to create a tsunami, which overwhelms Dranzer. Kai is desperate for victory and Voltaire makes him a tempting offer: the power of Black Dranzer in exchange for betraying his friends and stealing their Bit Beasts. Kai stays true to his heart and resists his grandfather.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After Kai's first round loss to the Demolition Boys in the World Beyblade Finals, it's Ray's turn to take on Bryan in a best-of-three match. Ray learns the hard way that Bryan is a nasty competitor who'll do anything to win - including putting Ray himself through the ringer. When it's discovered that Bryan's attack includes the ability to manipulate air itself into a weapon, Ray faces a troubling realization. To negate Bryan's fury, he must put his own well being at risk. But Ray's Bit-Beast Driger has other ideas, and it offers up selfless act of its own.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After a devastating match puts Ray in the hospital, Tyson trains his heart out to prepare for his battle against Tala, leader of the Demolition Boys. What Tyson doesn't know is that Tala has become one of Boris' weird experiments, uploaded with dangerous Biovolt technology. Meanwhile, Max's parents work together to come up with an improved Beyblade that can combat the existing threat of the Demolition Boys' prowess. Can it even come close to competing against'Cyber-Tala?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It is the finals of the World Beyblading Championships in Moscow with Tala from the Demolition Boys and Tyson tied at one game a piece in the best of three finals. With the victory, the tide has turned in favor of Tala who warps the two warriors into a giant iceberg where there is no contact with the outside world. The second battle begins, and it takes little time for Tala to combine his multiple Bit Beasts into one and take the lead in the best of three finals. Meanwhile, the evil Voltaire, head of the Biovolt Corporation looks on and begins celebrating the victory, which translates into his domination of the corporate world.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help of Kenny and his Bit Beast Dizzi, who's trapped inside his laptop, Tyson prepares for the big battle, which he handily wins. But the just when the fight is over, the Blade Shark's leader Kai shows up and a new battle begins between Kai and Tyson

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his way back.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: For some strange reason, Mr. Dickenson has sent the Blade Breakers to a remote mountain retreat to hone their blading skills for the upcoming American Tournament as well as to get Kenny and Dizzi to figure out a way to increase Ray's Bit Beast's power. Once there, they meet up with a enthusiastic young boy named Antonio who they think is there to train them. Turns out, Antonio is a pathetic blader.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick Grimes, policía de una pequeña localidad de Georgia, despierta de un coma y repentinamente se encuentra en un mundo apocalíptico. Desorientado, en busca de su familia y una explicación a lo acontecido, Rick ha de adaptarse al nuevo orden.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick llega a caballo a Atlanta, donde encuentra una ciudad desolada. Tras escapar de una situación de peligro, Rick se une a un grupo de supervivientes en unos grandes almacenes, donde le espera un enemigo más peligroso que los zombis.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick regresa a Atlanta al sentirse culpable de haber dejado a Merle abandonado en un edificio asolado por zombis. En el campamento, la inesperada llegada de Rick causa tensión entre Lori y Shane, quien había asegurado que Rick había muerto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: En Atlanta, una banda armada sorprende al grupo de Rick mientras están buscando a Merle. Entretanto, en el campamento, Jim empieza a comportarse de forma extraña, tiene premoniciones y asusta a los niños con una tragedia que se aproxima.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras el ataque al campamento, Rick conduce al grupo hacia el CDC, un recinto de la base sanitaria militar, en el que esperan encontrar un refugio seguro. Durante el trayecto, Jim debe tomar una decisión extremadamente difícil.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos. We also delve into the transformative impact of mindfulness on underprivileged children, highlighting how these ancient practices empower young lives. Rooted in India's rich cultural heritage, the episode reveals how the nation's spiritual traditions provide both sanctuary and a deeper connection to ourselves and the broader world. Join us for this enlightening expedition as we unravel the power of mindfulness and how we can incorporate it into our daily lives no matter where we live.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: In the emotionally charged episode host Mike honors a deeply personal commitment to his late father, who passed away from cancer, to seek out the true meaning of happiness. Following this heartfelt promise, we venture to Bhutan, a remarkable country where happiness is not merely an emotion, but a national policy ingrained in its culture. From the lively capital of Thimphu to the peaceful farmlands of Punakha, we explore how Bhutan has seamlessly woven well-being into all aspects of life—from its education system that teaches happiness as a subject to its communities that prioritize collective well-being. This journey serves as both a tribute to Mike's father and an investigation into how Bhutan's unique approach to happiness could offer transformative insights for our own lives. Join us on this poignant and enlightening trip to the Land of the Thunder Dragon as we delve into what happiness truly means, fulfilling a promise and enriching our understanding of life's greatest pursuit.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E01 - Costa Rica
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore Zunya, an eco-village, and its enchanting blue zone concept. We delve into communal living, uncovering its allure. At La Senda, we experience soul cleansing Temazcal and a sublime cacao ceremony. We engage in a farm-to-table activity, savouring locally sourced ingredients. Cala Luna offers a rejuvenating body treatment amidst serene surroundings. We encounter the Maleku Tribes, witnessing their dance ceremony and visiting their cacao farm. The journey concludes with a breath taking hike and a majestic volcano view, reminding us of nature's beauty. This episode is a transformative adventure of self-discovery, cultural immersion, and connection with nature.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Iceland’s raw nature, good hearted people and vast open spaces encourage Scott and Justin to brave the elements. From Reykajavik the guys rent a 4x4 truck and hit the open roads, no matter what the conditions. They encounter a family while sheep herding, and join in to help on their way to find adventure in the ice and glaciers . Active volcanoes, ice climbing and squeezing into an underground lava tube hint towards some of the personal strength needed to continue their world adventures.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Scott and Justin ultimately find themselves in the midst of some of the most wild roads and dangerous animals on the planet. Sleeping in a tree-blind while lions walk directly under them or taking a walking safari is no match to the real situation with the people they meet. The guys experience a way of life that is so drastically different than theirs, impoverished and battling the HIV/AIDS epidemic, the guys witness the joy and sorrow at a small church ceremony and gain a fresh outlook from their new Zambian friends.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 148: Pascuita al borde, Matilde acecha
programme.desc: Después de verse obligado a pedirle a Gladys que se disculpase con Paco, Marco Aurelio le ofrece su apoyo incondicional a Gladys tras saber de la verdad de los motivos que la llevan odiar tanto a su cliente. Llevado por la curiosidad de no ver a Cristina Gerson se entera por medio de Mª Gracia de su paradero tras el castigo impuesto por Eglée de llevarla a vivir con su papa, Cristina sorprende a Gerson con su regreso a su casa siendo él el primero en enterrase de su decisión. Al ser testigo de las bromas pesadas que se juegan Aureliano y Dileidy, Luís Fernando se deja llevar por los celos al saber a Dileidy por lo menos preocupada por la recién iniciada relación entre Aureliano y Felicita. Luís Fernando al dejarse invadir por lo celos y el rechazo de Dileidy desahoga su frustración ante Santiago quien lo escucha pacientemente recordándole a su amigo sus limitaciones. Al sentirse aludida por los comentarios celoso y malintencionados de Luís Fernando Dileidy se enfrenta a el poniéndole un alto a sus reclamos para pasar a recordarle todo lo que ha sufrido ella por su causa y sin tener derecho a reclamarle nada por ser el un hombre casado. Cristina es la causante de los problemas de Gerson al insistir en hacer realidad su amor por el, Rómulo percatado ya de la fuga de Cristina de su casa presencia el encuentro entre su hija y Gerson. Gonzalo se aprovecha de la pésima relación que mantiene con su esposa Matilde para coquetear con Yenilú, Doroteo interrumpe a los amantes con su llegada para enterar a Gonzalo de su importante parentesco con Yenilú esperando así hacerlo respetar a su hija. Matilde se debate entre aceptar el cortejo de Moncho o intentar una vez mas arreglar su matrimonio con Gonzalo, Moncho por su parte informa a Matilde de la nueva operación de su esposa Pascuita. En la sala de operaciones Pascuita como paciente habitual de cirugía saluda alas enfermeras y a los doctores con un aire de amistad, al estar bajo los efectos de la anestesia Pascuita se atormenta con la posibilidad de llegar a perder a su esposo debido a la existencia de Matilde llegando a amenazarlo con morirse; en la sala de cirugías los médicos atraviesan una emergencia debido a la alucinación de Pascuita quien entra en estado de crisis al manifestar una hipotensión. Durante su cita con el psicólogo Felicita toma las múltiples cirugías de su madre como algo habitual no sintiendo ningún temor por la nueva intervención que sufre Pascuita. Al desear al esposo de su amiga Pascuita para si Matilde le desea la muerte, Moncho recibe un llamado urgente de la clínica de estética donde se encuentra su mujer mientras Matilde le declara su amor. Doroteo conversa con Gonzalo al saberlo el hombre en la vida de su hija Yenilú y para su pesar un hombre casado, Yenilú observa a distancia el encuentro entre Gonzalo y su padre dejándose abatir por los sentimientos encontrados en cuanto a la actitud asumida por Doroteo de dar la cara por ella después de por tantos años sufrir su abandono paternal. Entre tanto Rómulo confronta a Gerson asegurándose de ponerle al muchacho los puntos sobre las iés en cuanto a su hija Cristina, como típico padre protector Rómulo recarga toda la responsabilidad sobre los hombros de Gerson al considerarlo el único culpable de las aspiraciones de Cristina de llegar a estar a su lado, no dejándole opción al muchacho a una defensa. En la sala de operaciones Pascuita sufre un milagroso restablecimiento tras recapacitar sobre su situación con Moncho y no pretender dejarse arrebatar a su esposo por Matilde. Al sentirse vigilada por la actitud protectora de su padre Yenilú le reprocha a Doroteo su nueva preocupación como padre. En la clínica, en espera sobre noticias acerca de Pascuita, Matilde le confiesa a Edén su sentimiento de culpabilidad tras haber deseado su muerte. En la habitación Moncho conversa con Pascuita mostrándole a esta su preocupación tras su manía de operarse, Pascuita es clara con Moncho al decirle que regreso de la muerte por el. Al no poder apartar de su mente el hecho de que Aureliano se encuentre saliendo con Felicita Tatiana ve al muchacho en todas partes logrando con dicha obsesión un accidente automovilístico que involucra aun motorizado. Mientras La nena recuerda a Doroteo en compañía de Rosita, Tatiana recurre a la ayuda de su madre para informarla de su accidente. A su llegada al lugar del accidente Mª Antonia no ve otra opción que abalanzarse sobre Paco en agradecimiento por haber resuelto sin traumas el accidente en el que se vio involucrada su hija.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 93: El beso, la pelea y la estafa.
programme.desc: Robert entra en la habitación de Betania, ya que la puerta está abierta, y ve la escena de Betania y Luis Guillermo besándose. Vuelve a salir y luego llama para la invitación a la cena. Diego Andrés está bastante tomado y entra a la fiesta de celebración del compromiso de Alfredo y Marisela. Se pone a gritar y no cree en lo que le dicen que Marisela se va a casar con Marisela. Comienza una pelea donde Alfredo le da un puñetazo y lo tumba. Marisela sale a acariciar a Diego Andrés, pero Alfredo no la deja. Luis Guillermo le dice a Betania que él siento algo por ella pero que no sabe todavía que es. Bajan a la reunión, donde están todos. Comienzan a discutir y Berta dice que si no le muestran las evidencias de la estafa de Armando Malavé, ella no lo va a considerar como un asunto serio.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene le pide a Leonardo no compartir la misma cama luego de la boda hasta que él no esté seguro de su amor por ella. Mientras tanto, la esposa de Juan Pablo se aparece de sorpresa en la empresa y Maribel descubre que su enamorado es casado. Carlos Ernesto le dice a Irene que encontró varias inconsistencias en el caso del asesinato de su hermano y que quiere reabrir la investigación. Jimena se opone rotundamente y le pide a Carlos Ernesto que deje todo como está. Por otro lado, Coromoto descubre que falta la colección de relojes de Leonardo y le informa a Agustina quien, de inmediato, sospecha de Leo. Leo, mientras tanto, intenta convencer a Oriana su novia de que lo que está haciendo es completamente legal. Más adelante, Jimena va a visitar a Trinidad y descubre que Irene es su hija.

programme.title: Episodio 105: Dolor de Mercedes y Oportunidad para Manuel
programme.desc: Mercedes est lista para contarle a Socorro todo sobre la relaci n de Josefina con Salvador, pero Coc se adelanta a decirle lo de la enfermedad de Ramiro y es tal el dolor de Mercedes que destrozar a Josefina pierde importancia. Socorro y Mercedes van a casa de Ramiro, all encuentran a Barbie quien le pide a Mercedes que no le diga a Ramiro que ella sabe lo de la enfermedad. Socorro le dice a Barbie que Manuel est destruido. - Manuel se va de casa de Mar a y se queda en el club de box, all Pedro le dice que la vida siempre da otra oportunidad y le cuenta que se reencontr con su primera novia. Luego aparece Charo, Manuel le cuenta que termin con B rbara y Manuel y Charo deciden darse una oportunidad como amigos.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 105: Ricardo elige a Marisela y Gabriel se marcha
programme.desc: Ricardo discute con su madre y ella no puede explicarle que est pasando realmente y para cuando llega Gabriel Ricardo se le enfrenta y pone a elegir a Marisela entre los dos y Gabriel decide marcharse. Jes s ve el bast n de Fernando y decide llev rselo para ganar puntos con l. Gabriel se cruza con Gabriela y le pide que no visite a Marisela porque Ricardo est all y est molesto y ella descubre con emoci n que el gran amor de su padre no es otra que Marisela. Jes s llega a la habitaci n de Daniel para enterarse de su salud y Caridad lo acusa de darle dinero sin control y permitir de esa forma que el muchacho malograra su vida. Fernando y Chela se dedican a buscar el bast n extraviado y deciden darle el p same a Anselmi el p same por la muerte de su nieto.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 101: Secretos, Reclamos y la Busqueda del Testamento
programme.desc: Gabriel presiente que Ricardo es su hijo y Marisela se sorprende. Gabriela se quema al intentar cocinarle a su esposo. El padre Juan le obsequia a Yolanda manzanas, su fruta preferida y recuerdan su noviazgo. Gabriel le insiste a Marisela que Ricardo es su hijo, ella lo niega. Gabriela lamenta no poder atender a Ricardo como debería, Jenniffer interrumpe. Mirna le reclama a Jesús todo lo ocurrido en el lobby del hotel pero a él le fastidia su aptitud. Isadora también está furiosa con lo ocurrido, Aurora la interrumpe y comenta que si Alfonso va a vivir a esa casa pus ella se va. Mientras éste amenaza con matar a quien le robó su máscara. En la habitación de Braulio, Flavia busca el testamento.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 102: El Desmayo de Marisela y La Mascara
programme.desc: Isadora empuja a Marisela por las escaleras y ella finge haberse caído también, Aurora se asusta al verlas tiradas en el suelo pero le preocupa aún más Marisela, quien se desmayó. Gabriel no logra tranquilizar a Yolanda quien sufre de claustrofobia. Víctor Manuel no entiende la actitud de Ricardo al besarse con Jenniffer. La servidumbre excepto Cachita, está preocupada por el desmayo de Marisela, nadie entiende qué pasó. En el bar el señor de seguridad le prohibe la entrada a Alfonso. Isabella logra hacer su show gracias a la máscara de Alfonso. Rambo le reclama a Candela y a Diana, quienes no le hacen caso y Percy, Pepe y la anfitriona ríen de la suerte de Rambo.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 103: El plan de Isadora y los celos.
programme.desc: A pesar de la caída, Marisela no ha perdido al bebé. Isadora le pide a Nancy que le ubique a un médico que la ayude a mentir. Ricardo cree que la propuesta que le hace Gabriela es porque ya no lo ama. Marisela comenta con Raúl que sus hijos son de ella nada más. programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 89: El Secreto de la Tia Emperatriz
programme.desc: Robert abre el escritorio de su padre para descubrir algún secreto de Armando Malavé y lo que consigue lo hace desfigurar de pánico. Todas las empresas y negocios que supuestamente eran de su padre, pertenecen a su tía Emperatriz. Cuando está viendo esto, aparece su hermana Daniela y se entera. Se ponen a pensar que su tía tuvo dos hijas. Si están vivas son las dueñas de todo. En la oficina de Berta en el Night Club están en plena discusión. Flavia se va con Indira y Diego Andrés la sigue para tratar de que se reúnan los tres, Flavia, Marisela y él para que se de cuenta de que Marisela es la hija. Flavia le dice que no. En la oficina mientras tanto Berta y Michelle están insultando a Marisela.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 90: Encuentros en la clinica y secretos revelados
programme.desc: Daniela va a visitar a su mamá a la clínica. Cuando llega se encuentra con el comisario y no le gusta mucho ese encuentro. También ve en otra habitación a Luis Guillermo visitando a Patricia que casualmente es amiga de Cinthia, la gran amiga de Flavia. Alfredo y Diego Andrés van a la casa de Darío a buscar a Marisela. Cuando llegan se consiguen con la dueña de la casa que les cuenta que botó a Marisela de allí por inmoral. Carolina va a echarle aceite al carro y no tiene dinero. Conoce a Darío y éste le dice que en otro momento lo ague. Carolina le dice que mejor lo invita. Quedan pendientes para una salida. El Comisario Escobar le envía unas flores a Flavia y un médico para que la cuide.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 91: Marisela sin casa, Alfredo propone matrimonio
programme.desc: Marisela se fue para la casa de Alfredo, ya que había sido botada de la casa de Darío. Cuando Alfredo llega a su casa, se la encuentra allá. Alfredo le dice que se case con él para que se le acaben todos sus problemas. Carolina le dice a Diego Andrés que ya consiguió a Darío y que pronto averiguará la dirección de Marisela. Diego Andrés le informa que ya la consiguió pero que se volvió a ir, porque la casera de Darío la botó de la casa. Berta va a buscar a Flavia a la clínica. Cuando se van en el carro, Flavia le dice a Berta que se pare en una dirección determinada y le dice que se bajen para que ella vea quien se hizo pasar por el obstetra de Michelle

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 92: Daniela confronta a Patricia por Luis Guillermo
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo le dice a Patricia que no acepta el préstamo para cancelar la hipoteca de su casa. Que él casi no la conoce y que son muchos millones. Que la casa no es de él sino de Betania. La Señora Mercedes visita a Betania para llevarse a Raulito. La felicita por tener tremenda mansión con todo lo que hay adentro. Betania le dice que adentro lo que hay es problemas. Patricia va a la casa de los Nuñez para hablar personalmente con Betania y le dicen que no está que está de viaje. En ese momento llega Daniela y le frena justo al lado de Patricia como retándola. Se baja del carro y le pregunta que hacía ella saliendo con su novio que le explique. Patricia le dice que se lo pregunte a Luis Guillermo.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 93: El beso, la pelea y la estafa.
programme.desc: Robert entra en la habitación de Betania, ya que la puerta está abierta, y ve la escena de Betania y Luis Guillermo besándose. Vuelve a salir y luego llama para la invitación a la cena. Diego Andrés está bastante tomado y entra a la fiesta de celebración del compromiso de Alfredo y Marisela. Se pone a gritar y no cree en lo que le dicen que Marisela se va a casar con Marisela. Comienza una pelea donde Alfredo le da un puñetazo y lo tumba. Marisela sale a acariciar a Diego Andrés, pero Alfredo no la deja. Luis Guillermo le dice a Betania que él siento algo por ella pero que no sabe todavía que es. Bajan a la reunión, donde están todos. Comienzan a discutir y Berta dice que si no le muestran las evidencias de la estafa de Armando Malavé, ella no lo va a considerar como un asunto serio.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 144: Secretos, Despecho e Infidelidad Revelada
programme.desc: Doroteo y Mª Antonia mantienen en silencio sus reflexiones y pensamientos al verse envueltos en una firma de disolución de su matrimonio que ninguno de los dos quiere llevar a cabo en la afueras de la oficina Mª José y Paco hacen acto de presencia para presionar a Doroteo y Mª Antonio a darle fin a su matrimonio para que respectivamente ellos ocupar el lugar dejado. Rosita hace lo posible para que Doroteo y Mª Antonia se sientan en la confianza de echar para atrás los tramites de su divorcio al hacer hincapié en que esta bien arrepentirse, al sentirse indignados por la presencia de sus rivales en el lugar Doroteo y Mª Antonia llegan a la decisión de continuar con la disolución de su matrimonio para plantar su firma en los documentos de divorcio Paco y Mª José celebran en silencio la disolución del matrimonio entre Mª Antonia y Doroteo. En el consultorio de Edén, Pascuita se muestra vulnerable al desahogar la ansiedad acumulada por pretender durante toda su vida mantener un modo vivendis perfecto aplicando el mismo estilo para su familia y su vida marital, decidiendo reparar las carencias de su propia vida con cirugías estéticas. Matilde por su parte al no poder contar con el apoyo de su esposo Gonzalo se hace cargo ella sola de planificar su vida y la de sus pequeños hijos, entre tanto en un restaurante Gonzalo le hace el cortejo a Yenilú, siendo descubiertos por Rómulo y Moncho. Al tratar de justificar su infiel actitud ante Rómulo y Moncho, Gonzalo da pie a darle el permiso a Moncho para que este pueda así decidirse a cortejar a su esposa Matilde. A su llegada a la oficina para resolver un asunto de trabajo Matilde le pregunta a Dileidi por el paradero de Gonzalo al encontrarse ignorante de que su esposo mantiene un romance clandestino con la recepcionista de la empresa donde ambos trabajan, Rómulo Moncho y Dileidi se ven obligados a mantener el secreto dicha relación para así no causar la separación entre Gonzalo y Matilde convirtiéndose así en los solapadotes de la infiel situación de Gonzalo. Edén asume la actitud de Pascuita como un caso psicológico interesante. Debido a las múltiples desilusiones sufridas por causa del rechazo de Dileidi Aureliano se decide a darle rienda suelta a su interés por Felicita. En el consultorio del obstetra Luís Fernando se deja sorprender al ver a su bebe por primera vez durante el examen de ultrasonido. Después de recibir un extenso regaño por parte de Dileidi debido a la relación que intenta mantener con un hombre casado Yenilú en son de broma intenta hacer recapacitar a Dileidi al aconsejarle que no maltrate más con sus confesiones de amor hacia Luís Fernando a Aureliano porque podría correr el riesgo de quedarse sola. Aureliano con su apasionada demostración hace que Felicita se olvide de sus propios traumas u obsesiones. Al ir en busca de Matilde para consolarla Moncho piensa en el consejo de Rómulo decidiendo no revelarle a Matilde nada acerca de la infidelidad de Gonzalo a pesar de que ello le dejaría la puerta abierta para intentar su conquista, Pascuita interrumpe la conversación entre Matilde y Moncho haciendo un alto definitivo en las intenciones de Moncho de pretender ganar puntos a su favor ante Matilde. Rómulo se desahoga ante su ex esposa Egleé al informar a esta sobre su hastíedad tras ser tomado por sus compañeros y familiares como el confesor de sus penas, Egleé se aprovecha del mal humor de Betzaida para exacerbar su conducta al recomendarle un brujo llamado Ángel tras llegar a la conclusión de que el Ángel a la que ella le prodiga tanta admiración es el brujo Ángel, entre tanto en la bodega de Remedios Ángel no cesa de hablar y recordar a su modelo Betzaida sin sospechar que la mujer que llama tanto su interés le ha mentido para no confesarle que es casada. Mª José acompaña a Doroteo durante su despecho por haber llevado a cabo la disolución de su matrimonio con Mª Antonia, Paco hace lo mismo al acompañar a Mª Antonio durante su momento de vulnerabilidad.

programme.desc: From the serene beauty of one man's architectural love poem to a woman, the Taj Mahal, to the crowded alleys of downtown New Delhi, India is a feast for the senses. Maxa discovers temples straight out of Disneyland and consults a street astrologer who tells him he will live a long life.

programme.title: Rudy Maxa's World
programme.desc: Tour the royal rooms behind the sandstone walls of the Mehrangarh Fort, perched high above the city of Jodhpur. In the countryside outside of Jodhpur, villagers, who have never seen a Westerner, invite Rudy Maxa into their homes, and the maharajah of Jodhpur explains why his palace is now a hotel.

programme.title: Andiamo! Uptown
programme.desc: Join Donna and visit a jewel of an Asian country- Singapore. Experience a place that weaves a confluence of cultures into its fabric, evident in the city's unique cuisine. Witness acrobat training, explore the fine art of tea, and more.

programme.title: Andiamo! Uptown
programme.desc: Travel with Donna to Thailand for a special three-part episode of Anidamo! Uptown. We begin in Bangkok and Hua Hin where Donna explores the cities' culture and cuisine. Also, witness a Muay Thai boxing match, and more.

programme.title: Moments in Time with Elia Locardi
programme.desc: Ari Amphibia take Elia to Jakarta's two best vantage points to capture the cityscape. After a successful photoshoot, Elia joins Gathot Subroto on a trip to a wet market, then heads to Dutchtown for a bike ride.

programme.title: Moments in Time with Elia Locardi
programme.desc: Elia battles mud and heavy crowds to capture one of the best sunrise photos in the world. Later, he joins Fujifilm X-Photographer La Mo to explore the peaceful Ta Som temple where they capture some beautiful shots of a Buddhist monk.

programme.title: Discovering the World
programme.desc: Hop from one atoll to another and become familiar with the Maldives the way Maldivians see their home. Indeed, the region's location is idyllic, and the ever-smiling locals will confirm what you were already thinking: theirs is the most beautiful country in the world, and it is worth caring for.

programme.title: WaterVoyagers - Chinese Adventures
programme.desc: See the sights and sounds in Chongqing, the Yangtze River and of course pandas.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: Mickela discovers the diversity and multifaceted cultural history of the metropolitan Malaysian city of Kuala Lumpur through the city's Chinese, Indian, and Malay dance influences.

programme.title: The New China
programme.desc: As one of the few man-made structures that is visible from outer space, up close, the Great Wall of China is extraordinary to behold. Here, you will travel the entire length of the Wall. Beginning in Lanzhou, trek across great expanses of China all the way to the end of the Great Wall in Jiayuguan.

programme.title: Jeremy Pang's Asian Kitchen
programme.desc: Jeremy kicks things off with a fragrant Turmeric and Dill Fish dish. Student Joe Swash's first lesson is Duck Spring Rolls. Jeremy also visits an oyster farm and hits the beach where he prepares oysters three ways. Got room for ice cream?

programme.title: Jeremy Pang's Asian Kitchen
programme.desc: The dishes Jeremy showcases are perfect for the family, beginning with a Malaysian Chicken Curry. Joe Swash focuses on Vegan Pad Thai. At the barbecue, Jeremy cooks up Korean BBQ Beef and Banchan, and for dessert, a Macha Mille Crepe Cake.

programme.title: Rhys Darby In Japan
programme.desc: Rhys learns the tricks of the trade from Japan's #1 mascot, battles a roboticist, experiences the relaxation of forest bathing, and trains with a samurai master.

programme.title: Me, Myself, and the World
programme.desc: Pamela visits the beautiful island of Bali, Indonesia, inspiring others to join her Solo Travel Revolution. She takes a Batik Class, visits local eateries in Ubud, and offers travel tips in her segment "Packing with Pamela."

programme.title: Me, Myself, and the World
programme.desc: Pamela continues her visit to the beautiful island of Bali, Indonesia, inspiring others to join her Solo Travel Revolution. She explores Bambu Indah, takes a Balinese cooking class, and offers travel tips in "Packing with Pamela."

programme.title: Moments in Time with Elia Locardi
programme.desc: Elia explores Singapore with fellow photographers Edward Adios and Mindy Tan who show him the best vistas in the city. They scout Marina Bay and the Helix Bridge then return during Blue Hour to capture the incredible laser show.

programme.title: Moments in Time with Elia Locardi
programme.desc: Elia visits street food stalls on Clarke Quay then checks out a stunning water feature at the mall. He explains the difference between shooting RAW and JPEG, then is surprised with a photography challenge in one of the strangest places.

programme.title: Grannies on Safari
programme.sub-title: Japan: The Contemporary and the Ancient
programme.desc: Spend exciting evenings in two of Japan's greatest cities: Tokyo and Kyoto. Experience Japan's temples, restaurants, and architecture. Retreat to Kusatsu, a mountain village at the base of a volcano, soak in therapeutic sulfur springs, and enjoy the ultimate spa experience.

programme.title: Grannies on Safari

programme.title: Rudy Maxa's World
programme.desc: Andaman Coast towns such as Phuket are well known to backpackers and sun seekers. programme.title: Rudy Maxa's World

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Italy is one of the very few nations in the world that regularly gets three major extreme natural phenomena – volcanos, flooding, and avalanches. Eastern flanks of the volcano to slip by up to two metres, and many houses on the flanks of the volcano experienced structural damage. The eruption also completely destroyed the Rifugio Sapienza, on the southern flank of the volcano. The Rifugio was the site of a cable car station which had previously been destroyed in the 1983 eruption; both have now been rebuilt. The most recent eruption was in November 2006.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: Angry Planet | By Camel to Timbuktu
programme.desc: It is time for “Angry Planet” to do a serious desert episode. What better place to do it than this fabled city in the middle of the mighty Sahara Desert.This almost mythical place really does exist. And it really is still possible to travel there by camel caravan, riding the infamous “Ships of the Desert”. Extreme heat, dehydration, possible sand storms, frigid night temperatures and desert predators are our potential companions for the trip.

programme.title: Amor en Whitbrooke
programme.desc: A una ambiciosa gestora de proyectos le ofrecen la oportunidad profesional de su vida en Londres. Pero cuando regresa a su ciudad natal para ayudar al negocio familiar en una emergencia y conoce al chico perfecto, su pasión y talento por la pintura se reavivan, dándole una nueva perspectiva de la vida y el amor.

programme.title: Cambio De Rumbo
programme.desc: Después de recibir malas noticias sobre la salud de su padre, James regresa a casa de mala gana para ayudar con el negocio familiar, un alojamiento y desayuno. Allí se enfrenta a un trabajo servil que abandonó con entusiasmo antes, y a un hermano con el que no se lleva bien. Aunque anhela irse tan pronto como pueda, descubre que el negocio está teniendo problemas. James enfrenta las tensiones con su hermano y debe decidir qué está dispuesto a sacrificar por los que ama.

programme.title: Buscando a Perséfone
programme.desc: Persephone Lancaster se casa con el temido duque de Kielder para salvar a su familia. En su aislado castillo, ella busca pequeños momentos de felicidad, pero la determinación de Adam de mantenerla a distancia pone en peligro sus frágiles esperanzas de un futuro juntos.

programme.title: Izzy Y La Bestia

programme.title: Entrenando A Tu Esposo
programme.desc: Jillian es una exitosa terapeuta matrimonial y autora de libros de autoayuda sobre el matrimonio. Como su relación no va muy bien, intenta arreglar su propio matrimonio enfocándose en cómo cambiar a su esposo.

programme.title: No Me Llamen Cenicienta
programme.desc: La vida aparentemente perfecta de Indy es puesta patas arriba tras un accidente con Bryant, el cual le ayudará a descubrir quién es.

programme.desc: Rebecca, una "mejoradora" de imagen de increíble éxito que se especializa en sacar a relucir la mejor versión de uno mismo, se enfrenta a su reto más formidable hasta la fecha en el encantador pero muy estancado en sus costumbres, Clive, una antigua estrella del fútbol.

Juntos cruzan la frontera en busca de un alijo de oro mientras O'Donnell fomenta una revolución. Los secretos del oro y una lucha de poder complican su misión.

programme.title: 15 horcas para un asesino

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Anna Koroleva es la primera belleza de la ciudad. Hace tiempo que se ha acostumbrado a la idea de que todo el mundo se interesa sólo por su aspecto. Está rodeada de flores y admiradores, muchos pretendientes. El bandido local Zhukov tampoco pudo resistirse a ella, pero Anna se mantiene inaccesible: no le gusta Zhukov. Contrata a unos matones para que den una lección de venganza a la terca belleza. Un transeúnte, Andrei Savin, es testigo del ataque y defiende a la chica. Inesperadamente, Anna se enamora de Andrei. Al enterarse de la aventura de Anna, Zhukov se enfurece. Al descubrir que su antigua amante está embarazada, le dice a Andrei que el bebé es supuestamente suyo, de Zhukov. Andrei intenta averiguar la verdad, pero Anna, ofendida por su desconfianza, declara que efectivamente está embarazada del bandido. Andrei la deja, Anna aborta. Si hubiera podido adivinar a dónde la llevaría su orgullo...

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Zhukov le dice a Andrei que el hijo de Anna es suyo. Andrei cree el rumor, lo que provoca que Anna termine la relación y aborte. Udalov asesina a Gushin, pero antes de morir, este logra decirle a Andrei el nombre de su asesino. Anna, al ver a Andrei consolando a Natasha, la hija de Gushin, piensa que él ya no la ama y, en un acto de desesperación, intenta suicidarse. Su mejor amiga, Masha, la lleva al hospital. En venganza contra Andrei, Anna acepta casarse con Maks, el médico que le salvó la vida. Mientras tanto, Udalov establece en Rusia un negocio de adopciones ilegales de niños extranjeros, con la ayuda de la directora del hospital materno-infantil, María Serguéievna.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Andrei se casa con Natasha, quien está feliz, ya que siempre ha estado enamorada de él. Mientras tanto, el negocio de Maks enfrenta problemas, pues un poderoso mafioso llamado *El Amo* le exige pagar sus deudas. Para salvar el negocio de su esposo, Anna se convierte en amante de *El Amo*. Andrei recibe la visita de su amigo Vadim, quien está en Moscú investigando a Udalov por tráfico de niños. Juntos, deciden atraparlo. Anna y Andrei se reencuentran y sus sentimientos renacen, pero Natasha queda embarazada y Andrei no se atreve a abandonarla. Después de discutir con Andrei, Anna toma un taxi, pero los pasajeros, unos adolescentes drogadictos, intentan abusar de ella. En la lucha, uno de ellos muere.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Maks se divorcia de Anna y, aprovechando su detención, la deja sin nada. Andrei intercede ante un alto funcionario (el padre del joven fallecido) para evitar que el caso de Anna avance, ya que ella es inocente. Anna es liberada. Vadim invita a Andrei a Moscú, donde abren una agencia de detectives. Natasha apoya la decisión de su esposo y lo acompaña, pero su matrimonio se deteriora, ya que Andrei no puede olvidar a Anna. En la estación de tren, Anna salva a un hombre de un intento de asesinato: es Udalov. *El Amo* había enviado a un sicario para matarlo por no compartir sus ganancias en el tráfico de niños.

Incapaz de compartir su sufrimiento con sus padres, siempre ocupados con sus trabajos, Gaby se encierra en sí mismo mientras el bullying se intensifica. La madre de Guille encuentra un video violento en el móvil de su hijo y, aunque lo borra, Guille niega todo y se presenta como víctima ante el psicólogo escolar. - La historia da un giro inesperado cuando el dueńo de la pizzería favorita de Gaby, un mafioso secreto, podría tener una pista que cambiará radicalmente las cosas. La situación se complica aún más cuando los padres de los involucrados, absortos en sus propios problemas, no logran percibir la magnitud del sufrimiento de Gaby, dejándolo cada vez más aislado y vulnerable.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

Ezequiel and Fausto each celebrate the fall of the other and are united only by their intention to kill Rosa; Marcelina, feels fear and shame; Elda, assures that Rosa is there to take revenge. Projection of the video that shows how Fausto murdered Celso.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ezequiel receives a note from El Doliente, anticipating his death. The plan against Rosa Blanco failed. She continues to relate the events of the past; Ezequiel, forcing her to take the murder weapon, managed to get her to be blamed for this murder, for which she paid so many years of unjust imprisonment.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ezequiel tries to abuse Camila, a gloved hand hits him. Everyone blames Camila and she defends herself saying she did not see the murderer. Torrealba insists on interrogating her. Everyone: Octavia, Astrid, Max, Marcelina, Leandro, Gregorio and even Sebastián had motives to kill Ezequiel. Only Max is arrested, as the presumed perpetrator of the crime.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila pressures Alfredo by continuing with her plan, she reveals that Alfredo is her godmother's son, whom she abandoned when he was almost born. Elda alone, crying, because deep down she is not happy with what she did. Sebastian, shocked, when Axel confesses that Amelia's son is his.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Max informs Camila that he knows the whereabouts of Rosa Blanco. Fausto enjoys harassing Patricia and that he will pay, like Rosa Blanco, for a crime he did not commit. Alfredo goes to talk to Elda, he despises her as a mother, guilt and remorse torment her: it is part of the revenge for his betrayal of Rosa Blanco.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila accepts that Max is the man she has loved the most and confides that she feels a great hatred for Marcelina, because being her mother's best friend, she was the one who betrayed her the worst and left her in the street, when she was only a five year old girl. Max refuses to believe it.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila and Rosa swear that now nothing and no one can separate them. Rosa wants to be reunited with her sister, Mother Isabel. Rosa, alone with her sister, shows her true face: cold, calm and above all vengeful. The two sisters confront each other over what they want for Camila.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Max now understands why Camila did not marry him. Max and Camila meet with Rosa. Rosa Blanco and Fausto plan to ally themselves to bring down Ezequiel, but he does not trust her and thinks it is a trap for him and so he decides to ally himself with Ezequiel, with the purpose of murdering Rosa.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Inspector Torrealba demands that Rosa testify about what happened in the past crime of Leoncio Lopez Mendez. With pain she relives the moments when Ezequiel arrived and murdered Leoncio and then left the place without any remorse. Fausto and Ezequiel continue with their plan to murder Rosa Blanco so that she does not tell what she knows.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.title: Princesa Mia

programme.title: Princesa Mia

programme.title: Princesa Mia
programme.desc: Alicia cree que sus tíos son los responsables de su secuestro y se lo dice a su abuelo. La princesa quiere reconocer a Davin con una medalla por salvarla. La doble de la princesa es asesinada.

programme.title: Saras y Kumud
programme.desc: Ante la insistencia de Vidyachatur, Saraswati habla con Laxminandan por teléfono. Ella aprecia los sacrificios de Kumud por Saraswatichandra y le ordena que la impresione de una manera única.

programme.title: Saras y Kumud
programme.desc: Saraswatichandra lleva a Kumud de vacaciones. Pero sufre un accidente mientras intenta salvar a un peatón, Khushi, quien rescata a Kumud de un accidente. Se enteran de que Khushi está embarazada y que estaba intentando suicidarse.

programme.title: Saras y Kumud
programme.desc: Khushi le informa a la pareja que ama a Vijay, pero que no puede casarse con él porque sus familias tienen rivalidad entre ellos. Luego, Saras organiza una reunión con Vijay.

programme.title: Saras y Kumud
programme.desc: Kumud informa a Vijay sobre la condición de Khushi. El tío de Vijay sospecha de Kumud, pero ella logra engañarlo. Saraswatichandra evita que la madre de Khushi la mate. La madre de Khushi quiere que aborte.

programme.title: Saras y Kumud
programme.desc: Saraswatichandra y Kumud reúnen a Khushi y Vijay. Mientras tanto, la madre de Vijay y Vikrant llegan al lugar. Las familias de Vijay y Khushi se acusan mutuamente. Pero finalmente se dan cuenta de que Vikrant es el responsable de la rivalidad.

programme.title: Saras y Kumud
programme.desc: El ginecólogo declara que Kumud y su feto están sanos. Vidyachatur decide trasladar a Kumud a una habitación en la planta baja. Saraswatichandra la lleva a su habitación. Piensa en sus responsabilidades después de convertirse en padre.

programme.desc: Iñaki vuelve de fiesta con los amigos y se encuentra a su madre preparando las maletas para salir a Sevilla. Por cosas del destino, Iñaki se ve obligado a ir con ella.

programme.title: Alli Abajo
programme.desc: Iñaki se va acostumbrando al lugar y al sentido del humor de la gente del sur. Sólo tiene que lidiar con el enviado del seguro para poder trasladar a su madre de vuelta a la verde Euskadi.

programme.title: Alli Abajo

programme.title: Cárteles Unidos
programme.desc: El gobierno ha declarado la guerra a todos los cárteles del país. La consigna es acabar con el crimen organizado. Organizaciones criminales que se disputan territorios clave y defienden los propios a sangre y fuego.

programme.title: El As De Oro
programme.desc: Manuel regresa a su pueblo tras estar preso por una falsa acusación. Viene a comprobar su inocencia y casarse con quien fuera su prometida.

programme.title: Los Criminales Del R1
programme.desc: Sandro es un joven ambicioso que ni compra, ni hace pactos, simplemente arrebata. Su rival es Luís Pacheco, un hombre astuto y vanidoso. Sandro desea el control total de la plaza, por lo que está punto de arremeter a sangre y fuego.

programme.desc: Una historia de corrupción y de avaricia entre un policía corrupto que trabaja para el mejor postor y un hombre que traiciona a violentos cárteles.

programme.title: La Riata Del Charro Chano
programme.desc: La historia de El Charro Chano', un hombre de renombrada fama por su habilidad con la pistola y su vestir de riata larga. El sueño de las mujeres y la envidia de los hombres.

programme.title: El Herradero, Hombres de Ley
programme.desc: En el pueblo de Hidalgo, Texas vive Don Berna García y quien está enamorado de una mujer comprometida. Cuando éste se entera que se va a casar, mata a su amada y ahí empieza la revancha de su prometido Chava.

programme.title: Le Firmé Un Contrato Al Diablo

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot

programme.sub-title: Def Leppard - Hysteria At The O2

programme.sub-title: The Who: Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
